scientific_integrity: An analytic dimension-uniform bound for the uniform two-player, single-update Hamming-rendezvous game; all-parameter proof in RESULT.md, independent of finite numerical tests.
scientific_limitations: Conservative rather than optimal gap; valid for integers \(t\ge2\) and \(d>2t\), uniform ordered inputs and exact t-coordinate outputs; does not classify quantum versus classical advantage, or other input laws.
title: A dimension-uniform quantum gap for higher-cardinality hypercube rendezvous
